image_description: Two individuals standing outdoors on a grassy lawn wearing academic regalia. The person on the left wears a black gown with pink velvet panels and a mortarboard cap, holding a scroll. The person on the right wears a blue doctoral gown with three velvet bars on the sleeves and a soft tam cap. Both are barefoot or wearing white socks/shoes that appear inconsistent with formal wear.
